name: Musée du Louvre
body: security.txt, a strict content security policy, and framing denied. robots.txt even keeps AI bots off images only. But the exhibitions, events, and guided-tours pages all share one title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title that leads with its topic. Tabs, bookmarks, and search results all show it.
summary: www.louvre.fr scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 17 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 14 pages have no meta description.

fix.title: 14 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en/visit/map-entrances-directions, /en/visit/visit-as-a-group, /en/visit/visit-as-a-family, /en/visit/list-of-available-galleries and 10 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 1 page asks search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 5 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: security.txt has expired
fix.evidence: Expires: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Researchers may ignore an expired file.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Exhibitions and Events - News and programming" on /en/exhibitions-and-events/exhibitions, /en/exhibitions-and-events/events-activities, /en/exhibitions-and-events/guided-tours.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 5 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /en/visit/visit-as-a-group (68), /en/visit/visit-as-a-family (68), /en/visit/visitor-amenities (82), /en/visit/accessibility (74) and 1 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
